items.title: 73243_Joe Thomas oral history interview
items.q: He's owner of, he called it the Grande Terrace and he took me back to times when I was a boy... we got together.

ctx.x: Well, what happened was he was a little over confident around that time. This was '35, '36 and we closed the Roseland so a fellow from Chicago, Ed Fox. I don't mind mentioning his name. I thought he was a tremendous guy and we got together. He's owner of, he called it the Grande Terrace and he took me back to times when I was a boy - come in (expected) all the lights. ... and we had a theme song -- I can't remember the name of it (he sings the tune). It was Hawk's song (?) you know.
